name: Mashed Peas on Toast with Fresh Tomato
instructions: Peel and mince shallots and garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add oil and swirl to coat the bottom of the skillet; add shallots and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add peas and water to pan; cook until almost no liquid remains, about 5 minutes.
Wash and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Add pea mixture and mayonnaise to the bowl with the lemon juice; season with salt and pepper. Using a potato masher, mash until almost smooth.
To serve, spread mashed peas over toast, top with tomato, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
